items: A widow discovers her late husband's second cellphone hidden in the garage, still receiving daily texts from an unknown number.
Two strangers realize they've been accidentally living in the same vacation rental and neither wants to leave first.
A surgeon notices her hands shaking during a routine procedure for the first time in twenty years.
The last employee at a closing bookstore must decide which hundred books to save from the dumpster by morning.
A teenage shoplifter recognizes the security guard as her elementary school best friend who moved away.
An elderly man plants a tree he knows he'll never see fully grown in his neighbor's yard without permission.
A translator realizes the confession she's interpreting in court contradicts what the defendant told her privately yesterday.
The new tenant finds polaroids hidden behind wallpaper showing the apartment arranged exactly as it is now.
A pilot smells smoke in the cockpit but all instruments show normal on a flight over the ocean.
A daughter searches her unconscious mother's purse for insurance cards and finds adoption papers instead.
The only witness to a parking lot accident must choose between being late to his own wedding or stopping.
A chef tastes a dish and realizes someone in her kitchen is trying to sabotage the restaurant's final review.
An archaeologist unearths a time capsule buried only three years ago containing her own missing wedding ring.
The dog a family is about to adopt at the shelter clearly recognizes their youngest child but won't approach.
A janitor finds a suicide note in a school bathroom trash can dated for tomorrow.
Two people reaching for the same library book discover they're reading it for opposite reasons in the same trial.
A man house-sitting for his brother finds a locked room that wasn't mentioned in any instructions.
The postal worker notices a regular customer hasn't collected mail in nine days in the middle of summer.
A woman boarding a train sees her supposedly dead father standing on the platform but the doors close.
An exterminator in a basement discovers evidence that someone has been living in the walls for months.
The backup singer realizes mid-concert that the star has changed the lyrics to confess something terrible.
A nurse draws blood from a patient and recognizes the rare genetic marker she was told only she had.
Someone discovers their therapist has been taking notes in a language they suddenly realize they can read.
A lighthouse keeper finds fresh footprints leading away from the tower on an island accessible only by boat.
The photographer developing film from an estate sale recognizes her childhood home in pictures taken decades before her birth.
A mechanic finds a bag of cash hidden in a customer's engine but the customer died before picking up the car.
An insomniac watching security footage of her own apartment sees herself sleepwalking into frame doing inexplicable things.
The medium hired for a party realizes the deceased person she's pretending to channel is actually in the room.
A cartographer notices the map he's restoring shows a highway exit that was never built but he remembers using.
Someone trying on vintage clothes finds a lottery ticket in the pocket for a drawing that hasn't happened yet.
The census taker arrives at an address that shouldn't exist according to all official records but clearly does.
A piano tuner opens a grand piano and discovers it's been converted into an elaborate living space for mice.
The fact-checker realizes every source cited in a viral article leads back to documents she herself forged years ago.
A swimmer surfaces after a dive to find the beach completely empty though it was crowded seconds before.
The new hire recognizes company software code as containing a message she wrote to herself in college.
A child's imaginary friend starts leaving physical objects that only the increasingly worried parent can see too.
The antique dealer realizes the mirror she just sold shows reflections three seconds behind real time.
A hitchhiker notices the driver has passed the same landmark four times without turning around.
Someone cleaning out a dead aunt's attic finds detailed journals describing their own life written before they were born.
The locksmith called to open a safe discovers it's been locked from the inside.
